caption: The worked example run end to end: a sensor sends one 512-byte sample every 30 minutes, and 10,000 such devices together upload 245.76 MB per day. The shaded final box is the fleet total that the exam asks for.

spec.title: Worked example 1: uplink per day
spec.aria: A downward four-step flow: 10,000 sensors each sending 512 bytes every 30 minutes give 48 samples per day, then 24,576 bytes per device per day, then 245,760,000 bytes for all devices, and finally 245.76 MB uploaded per day.
